title: Scania R650 new generation FUPS Polished Hi-tensile custom Bullbar #3
description: Scania R650 new generation FUPS Bullbar. The opening in the lower bar allows the AEB (Advanced Emergency Brake) and the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) to operate without any interference from the cab protection awarded by the Bullbar. Combination indicator repeater/daylight running lights are recessed in the outer box uprights. 76mm high tensile aluminium pipe with 6mm thick wall and custom driving light mounts to customer requirements.
